Running command: cd /tmp/asanbuild && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
parser_flags = 0x80000  # MD_FLAG_ADMONITIONS
renderer_flags = 0
header = struct.pack('<II', parser_flags, renderer_flags)
md = b"> text\n\n[!NOTE]\n"
data = header + md
open("poc.bin","wb").write(data)
print("len", len(data), "hex", data.hex())
PY
./fuzz_driver poc.bin 2>&1 | head -40; echo "EXIT=$?"
